The formal equations define a class of operators rather than state a theorem with premises and conclusion. Encoding the definition as premises and non-unitarity/sign-flip as conclusion would be tautological; checking a witness operator would be a side satisfiability calculation, not the main claim. The 'unique', 'adds external information', 'infinite divine source', and dependence on Laws VI/VIII require undefined notions, so the main claim cannot be faithfully encoded as a Z3 entailment.
